statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-62900 (GHSA-23fw-v26w-5fgq) is an information disclosure issue in the Source Link build tasks Microsoft.Build.Tasks.Git and Microsoft.SourceLink.AzureRepos.Git, which did not remove sensitive information before storing or transferring it. For .NET 8, Microsoft ships these tasks inside the SDK with SDK-specific prerelease versions and lists the fix as SDK 8.0.130, released with .NET 8.0.30 (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-23fw-v26w-5fgq, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/8.0/8.0.30/8.0.30.md). DHI dotnet8-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 8 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 220 packages of the ten published builds (8.0.23-r0, 8.0.24-r0, 8.0.25-r0, 8.0.26-r0, 8.0.27-r0, 8.0.29-r0, 8.0.31-r0, 8.0.32-r0, 8.0.33-r0 and 8.0.34-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the files inside the nupkg and other zip archives they hold. The tasks ship in the .NET SDK held by dotnet8-runtime-bootstrap and as Source Link nupkg files in dotnet8-runtime-artifacts. 8.0.23-r0 to 8.0.29-r0 hold SDK 8.0.123 to 8.0.129, whose Microsoft.Build.Tasks.Git and Microsoft.SourceLink.AzureRepos.Git are 8.0.0-beta.23615.1 (built from Source Link commit 94eaac3 of December 2023). 8.0.31-r0, the next published build, holds SDK 8.0.131 with 8.0.0-beta.26351.4 (built in July 2026), and later builds hold SDK 8.0.132 to 8.0.134 with 8.0.0-beta.26417.2. There is no 8.0.30 build. The range ends at 8.0.31-r0 because it is the first published build with the fixed SDK.
